people.name: Aroer
people.line: A city in Gad, built by the Gadites.

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

people.name: Jazer
people.line: A town in Gilead, allotted to Gad

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: They passed over the Jordan, and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and to Jazer;
translations.bsb: They crossed the Jordan and camped near Aroer, south of the town in the middle of the valley, and proceeded toward Gad and Jazer.
translations.kjv: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:
translations.asv: And they passed over the Jordan, and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and unto Jazer:
